description:
SAIC is seeking an Azure Data Software Engineer  located at Pearl City in Hawaii  to support USPACOM  to design, implement, and maintain a full-stack software system that provides Data Analytics and AI Services to a variety of Government stakeholders. The back-end system ingests raw data from diverse sources, enriches it through AI services, and delivers curated datasets for analytics and machine learning. The front-end system provides a catalog of services to end-users, including data visualizations, data ingest, and document generation. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 
 Design, build and maintain scalable data ingestion pipelines from diverse sources (APIs, databases, streaming feeds) into Azure Data Lake Storage.

 Integrate Azure AI services (e.g. Azure Machine Learning) into transformation workflows for intelligent enrichment.

 Optimize ETL/ELT processes for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.

 Collaborate closely with data scientists to ensure datasets are AI-ready and aligned with model requirements.

 Automate pipeline monitoring, error handling, and alerting via CI/CD integration.

 Participate in architecture reviews and contribute to best practices for data governance and security.

 

 Required: 
 Bachelor’s and five (5)+ years of related experience; additional four (4) years of experience considered in lieu of degree.
 Proven experience building data pipelines and a strong understanding of Medallion architecture principles and their practical implementation.
 Experience integrating Azure AI services into data workflows.
 Proficiency in Python, bash, and Javascript.
 Proficiency designing front-end UI/UX.
 Proficiency in graph-based architecture and software such as LangGraph.
 Proficiency in containerization and cloud deployment.
 Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD for data engineering.
 Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance best practices.
 Required Clearance: 
 Must have an active Secret clearance with ability to obtain a TS/SCI.
 Must be a current US Citizen. 
 
 SAIC®  is a premier mission integrator focused on advancing the power of technology and innovation to serve and protect our world. Our robust portfolio of offerings across the defense, space, intelligence, and civilian markets includes secure high-end solutions in mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services. We integrate emerging technology, rapidly and securely, into mission critical operations that modernize and enable critical national imperatives. 
 
 

 We are approximately 23,000 strong; driven by mission, united by purpose, and inspired by opportunities. SAIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC has annual revenues of approximately $7.3 billion. For more information, visit  saic.com . For ongoing news, please visit our  newsroom .
